title: 第七章 地心果
slug: 武神空间全本免费-武神空间最新章节列表
content_zh:
“昂！”
箭猪兽大吼一声，出人意料的并没有冲过来，而是转身就跑，虽然妖兽们的智商也就和寻常野兽差不多，和人类相比更是天差地别，但是在面对生死抉择的时候，他们反而比人类更为果决。
没想到，箭猪兽竟然会选择逃跑，越是低级的妖兽，智商就越是低，所以这样子就更出乎他们的预料之外了。
箭猪兽虽然看着很笨拙的样子，但是其实却拥有很多人都没想到的灵敏的身手，没一会儿，身影就要消失在丛林里。
叶希文哪里能让对方跑掉，提纵起全身的功力，脚下爆裂出真气，身法被他运用到了极致，身影仿佛是闪烁在云海之中的魅影，不过是片刻间的功夫，就追上了箭猪兽。
叶希文一路跟着箭猪兽出了树林来到一片空地之上，空地一边的一片悬崖上，横出一块大石头，居然有一株三寸高的植物，这植物的由六片绿叶拱卫着一颗赤红色的果实，散发着淡淡的果香。
五十年份的地心果生长在由天地元气汇集的灵土之下，叶希文回想起以往看到过这种草药的记载，是练成一种增加功力的丹药的主要成分，一般来说，五十年份的地心果练成的丹药能增加五年的功力，可以说是极为珍贵的。
叶希文顿时了然明白了为什么这只箭猪兽一开始会对他有这么大的敌意了，应该是误以为叶希文是为了争夺地心果才出现在这里的。
天材地宝的珍贵，不仅仅是人类知道，妖兽虽然灵智不高，但是却也是知道的，等到地心果熟透了之后，就会滚落下来，这头箭猪兽已经等了很久了。
叶希文展开云踪魅影，瞬间追了上去，在空中一个扭身，一掌按下。
“嘭！”
奔雷手被叶希文施展到了极致，每一掌都是势大力沉，就算是一个后天四重的武者都能抗衡，挨了一掌也要重伤，也亏得这箭猪兽，皮糙肉厚，也远非一般后天四重的武者能够媲美的，不然早就被叶希文给生生拍死了。
不过即便是这样，箭猪兽挨了叶希文这一掌也是直接被拍的脊椎骨都断掉了。
“吼！”箭猪兽惨叫一声，庞大的身躯轰然倒地，抽搐不已，叶希文哪里会放过这个机会，抓到空当一掌将他的脑骨都给直接打的崩裂了，鲜血夹杂着脑浆迸溅出来。
箭猪兽惨叫着断了气。
叶希文顿时有些难以置信，一头后天五重的妖兽居然被他三掌给拍死了，这才以往都是绝对难以想象的，一般妖兽都会比同级别的武者难对付的多了，现在居然都不是他的三掌之敌，这让他对于一个多月后的宗内大比有了信心。
叶希文没有客气，将箭猪兽庞大的身躯剖开，挖出其中的妖核，这种妖核就是妖兽的本命精华所在最是值钱不过了，虽然只是后天五重的妖核，但是起码也是价值二十枚下品灵石。
也正因为妖兽的妖核如此值钱，因此每年要去猎杀妖兽的人都是层出不穷，但是其中许多人都只能是作为妖兽的口粮，葬身兽口。
不过叶希文没有要将妖核给卖掉的想法，要是上缴给宗门，可以换的宗门的积分，宗门的积分在外面或许不值一钱，但是在宗里的用处可就大了，包括可以换来优秀的功法，增加功力的丹药，以及某一位长老的单独指点等，这些对于叶希文来说，比起银子可都要重要的多了。
在这个实力至上的世界中，只有拥有强大的实力才是根本，其他的都是浮云！

当然，箭猪兽身上的其他部分也是可以卖出一笔钱的，但是叶希文随身携带不下，就只能够放弃了！
将妖核收入囊中之后，叶希文顿时顺着悬崖开始攀爬，随着现在叶希文的功力进展，身体素质有了突飞猛进了，犹如猿猴一般，进退自如。
叶希文很快就攀爬到峭壁上的石块上，那一株地心果就在跟前，在风中颤颤巍巍，一阵药香扑鼻。
叶希文顿时伸手朝着地心果抓去，虽然五十年份的地心果药效不是最好，但是对于现在的叶希文来说，已经是再好没有了，能增加五年的功力，叶希文甚至能直接将功力推到后天四重巅峰。

content_en:
"Ang!"
The porcupine beast roared, and unexpectedly did not rush over, but turned around and ran away. Although the IQ of the monster beasts is about the same as that of ordinary beasts, and is very different from humans, when faced with life and death decisions, they are more decisive than humans.
Unexpectedly, the porcupine beast would choose to escape. The lower the level of the monster, the lower its IQ, so this was even more unexpected.
Although the porcupine looks very clumsy, it actually possesses agility that many people did not expect. After a while, the figure will disappear into the jungle.
Ye Xiwen couldn't make the opponent run away. He raised up all his strength, and burst out the true energy under his feet. He used his body skills to the extreme. His figure seemed to be a phantom flickering in the sea of ​​clouds. In just a moment, he caught up with the porcupine beast.
Ye Xiwen followed the porcupine beast out of the woods and came to a clearing. On a cliff on one side of the clearing, there was a large stone, and there was a three-inch-tall plant. This plant had six green leaves guarding a red fruit, exuding a light fruity fragrance.
The fifty-year-old earth core fruit grows under the spiritual soil where the vitality of heaven and earth gathers. Ye Xiwen recalled that he had seen records of this herb in the past. It is the main component of a pill that can increase one's skill. Generally speaking, the elixir made from the fifty-year-old earth core fruit can increase one's skill for five years, so it can be said to be extremely precious.
Ye Xiwen immediately understood why this porcupine was so hostile to him in the first place. He must have mistakenly thought that Ye Xiwen appeared here to compete for the core fruit.
Not only humans know how precious the treasures of heaven and earth are, but also monsters, although they are not very intelligent, also know that when the earth core fruit is ripe, it will roll down. This porcupine beast has been waiting for a long time.
Ye Xiwen unfolded the Phantom Cloud and immediately chased after him. He twisted in the air and pressed down with his palm.
"Bang!"
Ye Xiwen used the thunder hand to its extreme. Each palm was so powerful and heavy that even a fourth-level acquired warrior could resist it and would be seriously injured even if he received a slap. Thanks to this porcupine beast, with its rough skin and thick flesh, it was far beyond what ordinary fourth-level acquired warriors could match. Otherwise, Ye Xiwen would have killed him long ago.
But even so, the porcupine received Ye Xiwen's slap and his spine was broken immediately.
"Roar!" The porcupine beast screamed, and its huge body fell to the ground, twitching. How could Ye Xiwen miss this opportunity? When he caught the opportunity, he hit his skull with a palm, and blood mixed with brain matter spurted out.
The porcupine screamed and died.
Ye Xiwen was suddenly a little unbelievable. A fifth-level acquired monster was actually killed by his three palms. This was absolutely unimaginable in the past. Normal monsters are much more difficult to deal with than warriors of the same level. Now they are not his enemies with three palms. This gives him confidence for the sect competition in more than a month.
Ye Xiwen was not polite. He cut open the porcupine beast's huge body and dug out the demon core. This demon core is the essence of the demon beast and is the most valuable. Although it is only the acquired fifth level demon core, it is worth at least twenty low-grade spiritual stones.
It is precisely because the demon cores of demon beasts are so valuable that there are an endless number of people who hunt demon beasts every year, but many of them can only be used as food for the demon beasts and die in the beast's mouth.
However, Ye Xiwen had no intention of selling the demon core. If he handed it over to the sect, he could exchange it for the sect's points. The sect's points may not be worth a thing outside, but they are of great use in the sect, including exchange for excellent skills, pills to increase skill, and individual guidance from an elder. These are much more important to Ye Xiwen than money.
In this world where strength is paramount, only having strong strength is fundamental, everything else is just a cloud!
Of course, other parts of the porcupine can also be sold for a sum of money, but Ye Xiwen couldn't carry it with him, so he had to give up!
After pocketing the demon core, Ye Xiwen immediately started climbing along the cliff. With the advancement of Ye Xiwen's skills, his physical fitness has improved by leaps and bounds. He is like an ape, able to advance and retreat freely.
Ye Xiwen quickly climbed onto the rocks on the cliff. The core fruit plant was right in front of him, trembling in the wind, and a burst of medicinal fragrance assaulted his nostrils.
Ye Xiwen immediately stretched out his hand to grab the Earth Core Fruit. Although the effect of the fifty-year-old Earth Core Fruit was not the best, for the current Ye Xiwen, it couldn't be better. It can increase the skill for five years. Ye Xiwen can even directly push the skill to the acquired fourth level peak.
